author.name: Tuio Partners Correduría de Seguros, S.L.

description: Seguro Match helps users in Spain compare real home, car, and motorcycle insurance quotes in ChatGPT. The model opens a guided quote wizard; the embedded widget collects the required details (with catalog and address lookups), runs the quotes against authorized insurer systems, and shows comparable offers and coverage details. To skip the form, users can drag and drop their current policy document into the widget — it is processed server-side only (extracted text used solely to pre-fill the quote, never sent to the model). Final checkout happens on seguromatch.com; nothing is purchased inside ChatGPT.
